stemMd: A fitted line predicts monthly cost $y$ from usage $x$ by $y=12+0.8x$. What does the slope mean?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Every observed point lies exactly on the fitted line.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Predicted cost increases by 0.8 units for each additional usage unit.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Cost is always exactly twelve units.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Usage increases by twelve units whenever cost increases.

explanationMd: The coefficient of x gives the change in predicted y per unit change in x. It is 0.8 cost units per usage unit; the model does not assert zero residuals.

distractorRationale.a: A fitted model can have residual errors.
distractorRationale.c: Twelve is the intercept, not a constant total.
distractorRationale.d: This reverses variables and misuses the intercept.
